title: feat(plugin-auth): a SCIM group push grants the ordinary permission set its group mapping names
body:
Fixes #30959

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：身份提供商经 SCIM 推送的组，现在可以按平台管理员保存的映射，给组成员授予一个普通权限集；成员移出组，授权随之撤销。
- 为什么改：此前 IdP 推送的组只落库、不授权，客户必须把每个组成员关系再手工授一遍权限集（卡 #30959，裁决「以上都同意」）。
- 风险与回滚：映射永远不能授予管理员身份，保存时用 plugin-security 自己的组织边界判定拒绝；手工授予的权限从不被对账删除。回滚即撤掉本 PR，没有映射时行为与今天一致。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-group-projection.ts`（对账只删带本投影标记的授权），`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/idp-group-mapping-admin.ts`（保存时的边界拒绝），`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`（判定函数原样上提）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-group-projection.test.ts`，预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

An identity provider that pushes a group over SCIM now changes what its members may do, through a mapping a platform administrator saves.

- **Storage.** New platform object `sys_idp_group_mapping` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-idp-group-mapping.object.ts`): one row per mapping with typed columns `source_kind` (closed select, V1 value `scim`, the seam #30967 reuses for SSO group claims), `source_id` (the SCIM connection), `group_external_id` or `group_display_name` (exactly one), `permission_set` and `organization_id`. The data API only lists it. One row in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`.
- **Writer.** `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/scim/set-group-mapping` (`connectionId`, `groupExternalId` or `groupDisplayName`, `permissionSet`) and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/scim/delete-group-mapping` (`mappingId`), behind the same platform-admin gate as `/admin/scim/mint-credential`. Both are in the route ledger, its conformance pin and the two dogfood admin-route censuses. The organization is the one that owns the connection's credentials; a connection with no credential is refused `reference_not_found`, one owned by two organizations `rule_violation`.
- **Admin boundary.** The save refuses every set outside the organization boundary with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, field `permissionSet`, code `rule_violation`, and stores nothing: `admin_full_access`, the organization-administrator sets, the agent ceiling sets, a set with a superuser wildcard or an `adminScope`, and a set with a capability not scoped to the organization. The judgement is plugin-security's own `organizationBoundaryFailure`, lifted verbatim from a private method of `DelegatedAdminGate` to a module function (the method is now a one-line delegate) and served as an optional member of the registered `security` service. plugin-auth takes no dependency on plugin-security and keeps no copy of the list; it feature-detects the member and fails closed (`503`, nothing saved, nothing granted).
- **Spec.** One optional member, `ISecurityService.organizationBoundaryFailure?(setName: string)`, resolving to the failure reason as a string or `null` when the set is inside the boundary (`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`), declared in `registered-security-service-members.pin.test.ts`. Optional, so every existing implementer still type-checks.
- **Mechanism.** `scim({ … })` in `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` now takes the vendor `projection` (`createScimGroupProjection`). `roles.map` returns the connection's mapping rows that match the group (by external id when the row names one, else by exact display name); `roles.exists` re-judges the boundary at grant time; `reconcileUser` writes through the ObjectQL engine inside the SCIM transaction with the request's system context, so the audit actor is `svc:scim:CONNECTION_ID`. An engine refusal becomes the vendor's `APIError`, never a SCIM 500.
- **Provenance.** A projected grant carries `reason` = `scim-group-projection: provisioning domain 'ID'`. Reconcile deletes only rows with that exact marker, so a grant made by hand, including one for the same set, is never removed, and a set already held by hand is not written again. Saving or deleting a mapping re-runs the vendor's `reconcileSCIMProjection` for the connection, so the change applies to current members at once.
- **Last-admin guard.** Its texts no longer tell operators that "the SCIM group mapping is too broad": a mapping never moves administrator standing, so the refusal now says to grant another account administrator standing first.
- **Translations.** The new object's labels are translated in every translated locale `main` ships (now eight, with pt-BR and ru); the bundles are regenerated, and `bundle-ownership.test.ts` lists the object.
- **Ownership ceremony.** `@objectstack/cli`'s ADR-0131 D10 inventory (`organization-ownership-inventory.ts`) gains a row for `sys_idp_group_mapping` with the attribution fate, like `sys_connector_connection` beside it: every mapping row is written with its organization, so a NULL row has no producer. Without it `os migrate organization-ownership` refused any database holding the new table.
- **Censuses.** The tenant-audit census (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and its counts file) and the platform-object tenancy census are regenerated for the three new write sites and the new object; the page's hand-written figures are updated to the census.

**Follow-up:** the ADR recording this decision (mechanism, storage, admin boundary, vendor `@better-auth/scim` 1.7.12) plus one pointer line in ADR-0134 D4 comes as a second PR from this branch after this one merges, so its symbol anchors resolve against landed code. That PR says `Refs #30959`.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-group-projection.test.ts` drives the real producer: `AuthManager.handleRequest()` with a real SCIM bearer over `@better-auth/scim` 1.7.12, on a real ObjectQL engine over better-sqlite3, with mappings saved through the door's own function and judged by the real plugin-security `security` service over a test catalog.

| Row | Pin | Ablation (mutation → red) |
|---|---|---|
| (1) mapped group push grants the set, actor `svc:scim:okta-30959` | grant row + one insert with that actor | projection wiring removed → red; writer without the SCIM context → red |
| (2) member removed → grant revoked | row gone + one delete with that actor | projection wiring removed → red; writer without the SCIM context → red |
| (3) admin set refused at save | 400, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `[permissionSet, rule_violation]`, no row | boundary refusal disabled → red |
| (4) set outside the organization boundary refused at save | same shape | boundary refusal disabled → red |
| (5) provisioning with no mapping still works | SCIM create + PATCH 2xx, no grant | regression pin |
| CONTROL unmapped group | no grant | group match removed from `roles.map` → red |
| CONTROL hand-made grants (`admin_full_access` + the mapped set by hand) | untouched by push and removal | provenance marker check removed → red |
| save/delete reproject current members | grant appears on save, goes on delete | projection wiring removed → red |
| (S1) connection whose credential names no organization refused at save | 400, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `[connectionId, rule_violation]`, no row | door's no-organization check disabled → red |
| (S1) projection never writes a grant without an organization | org-less mapping read: no grant, one warning | reconcile's `admits` call removed → red; `admits` organization check disabled → red |
| (S2) reconcile judges the boundary itself: set redefined as administrator after the save | `reconcileUser` called without `roles.exists`: no grant, one warning; a real push then grants nothing | reconcile's `admits` call removed → red |

Each ablation ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob restored equal to HEAD). The three S1/S2 pins were committed red first (`cdd23489`) before the fix (`fe3aea79`).

## Acceptance notes

- Matching reading: each mapping row names exactly one group key, and matching is per row (external id when the row has one, else exact display name).
- Beyond the acceptance rows: saving or deleting a mapping reprojects current members at once, and the boundary is re-judged at grant time, so a set later redefined with admin bits grants nothing (warned once).
- Known edge: two provisioning domains that project the same (set, organization) share one grant row; the marker names the domain that wrote it.
- No Console surface for mappings in this PR; the two doors are the only writer.
- Serial with #30967: whichever lands second merges `origin/main` once and re-runs the plugin-auth and platform-objects suites.

## Verification

Head `42f60764`, after merging `origin/main` three times without rebasing (`1efd345f`, `ae12be81`, `52aa0fc6`, the last at `a61ddc93`, which includes the pt-BR and ru bundles). The first merge resolved `delegated-admin-gate.ts` by keeping #31384's helpers; the lifted predicate is still verbatim. The census artefacts were regenerated from main's copy.

- Build: `turbo run build` 120/120 tasks.
- Typecheck: `pnpm --filter PKG typecheck` (including each package's `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0 for plugin-security, platform-objects, plugin-auth, spec and cli; `check:type-check-debt` exit 0.
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the touched packages, exit 0.
- Suites on the merged tree: plugin-auth 4292 passed / 10 skipped; plugin-security 5886 passed / 45 skipped; platform-objects 1841 passed; cli 7582 passed / 9 skipped (unit and integration). The ownership-ceremony files (inventory unit, `dev-organization-ownership-stale-column`, `start-organization-ownership-refusal`, `declared-rule-mirrors`, `no-organization`, `sqlite-wasm`) were 10 red before the inventory row and are 42/42 green on `42f60764` with cli rebuilt.
- i18n: `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` (none new) and `check:i18n-stale-fill` exit 0 on the merged tree.
- Acceptance file: 11/11 passed; eight ablations red as listed under Tests.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 130 families; all 130 exit 0 and `--ran` reconciled 130 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-authoring` and `check:type-check-debt` were re-run on `42f60764`; the other 128 ran on `861c284a`, which differs only in that citation string.
- Line budget against `main`: 44 files, +1891 −100. Generated output (translation bundles in eight locales, two census artefacts and the tenancy census JSON) is 536 of it; authored is 24 files, +1397 −58.
